key_insight: Facts seen only once during training—called monofacts—help govern an LLM’s capacity for scientific discovery.
engineering_relevance: Training-data design that accounts for monofact rates could improve LLM-assisted materials discovery.
method: Model discovery capacity through missing probability mass.
Directly manipulate monofact rates in training data.
Test discovery across model families, sampling strategies, and reasoning budgets.
evidence_signal: In materials science and regulatory genomics, higher monofact rates consistently yielded more discoveries across two open-weight model families, with effects not explained by training-set diversity alone.
watch_item: Cross-domain transfer was demonstrated when paired with in-domain data, so monofact enrichment should not be assumed to replace domain-specific training.
paper_title: Tracing the Scientific Discovery Capacity of LLMs to Their Training Data
